Landing.heroSubtitle: Track Salah, Quran, Dhikr, daily habits and checklists — with streaks, heatmaps, and weekly goals to keep you consistent.
Landing.pillars_subtitle: Each prayer carries its own light. Track them with care, earn bonuses for Sunnah, Nafil, and Witr — and watch your weeks compound.
Landing.verse_main: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed with intention. Built for consistency.
Landing.feature_salah_desc: Mark each prayer's timing — Awwal, mid, last — with bonuses for Sunnah, Nafil, and Witr.
Landing.feature_quran_desc: Log pages or minutes read each day, and watch your progress compound over weeks.
Landing.feature_dhikr_desc: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illa Allah — set targets and stay consistent.
Landing.feature_habits_desc: Build any habit — fasting, charity, dua — with custom reward points.
Landing.feature_checklist_desc: Plan your day with a simple checklist, earn points for completion.
Landing.feature_visuals_desc: Weekly bars, monthly heatmaps, and streak counters keep you motivated.
Landing.cta_subtitle: Start tracking today. Let your week compound. Let your year transform.
Landing.proof_max_points_sub: From a perfect day of worship
Landing.how_subtitle: An honest rhythm built around three Prophetic principles — set your intention, do the deed with care, and reflect on what was given.
Landing.how_step1_desc: Pick the pillars that matter to you right now — Salah, Quran, Dhikr, custom habits — and let the rest stay quiet. No guilt-driven gamification.
Landing.how_step2_desc: Log each prayer's timing — Awwal, mid, last — and quietly record Quran reading, Dhikr counts, fasting, charity, dua. A few seconds, once a day.
Landing.how_step3_desc: See your weekly bars, monthly heatmaps, and streak counters. Notice the rhythm. Adjust with mercy. Let your year transform, ayah by ayah.
Landing.personas_eyebrow: Built for the people we know
Landing.personas_subtitle: Whether you're rebuilding a habit of prayer or steady for years, Ibadah meets you where you are.
Landing.persona_beginner_desc: You're learning the prayers, building wudu into your day, and need a gentle structure that celebrates small wins without shaming missed ones.
Landing.persona_beginner_help: Daily checklist · Custom habits · Gentle nudges
Landing.persona_consistent_desc: You pray five times daily and want to track Awwal-time prayers, Quran pages per day, and the Sunnah you're slowly adding to your routine.
Landing.persona_consistent_help: Awwal-time bonuses · Quran log · Witr & Sunnah
Landing.persona_returning_desc: You've been away. You don't want a leaderboard or a coach — just a quiet space to start logging again, see one streak grow, and feel hope.
Landing.persona_returning_help: Reset-friendly streaks · Private by default · No socials
Landing.faq_subtitle: What people ask before signing up. If your question isn't here, drop us a note.
Landing.faq_free_a: Yes — every feature is free. There is no premium tier, no ads, and no plans to add either. The app is built as a sadaqah jariyah by the team.
Landing.faq_auth_q: Is Ibadah affiliated with any madhhab or scholar?
Landing.faq_auth_a: No. We do not issue rulings or rank schools of thought. The defaults follow widely-accepted practice, and you can fully customize scoring, habits, and templates to fit your tradition.
Landing.faq_languages_a: English, Arabic (with full RTL layout), and Bangla. Arabic phrases are typeset in Amiri for proper Naskh rendering. More languages are planned.
Landing.faq_privacy_a: Your worship log is yours. We store only what's needed to sync across your devices, never sell data, and never use your records for training models or advertising.
Landing.faq_prayer_times_q: Does Ibadah show prayer times for my city?
Landing.faq_prayer_times_a: Not yet — Ibadah focuses on tracking the prayers you've already performed. We plan to add optional prayer-time integration without making it the focus of the app.
Landing.faq_scoring_q: Why are points part of a worship app?
Landing.faq_scoring_a: Points are visual feedback, not divine accounting. They help you notice patterns over weeks. You can edit every value in Settings — or ignore them entirely and just use the streak.
Landing.footer_madeWith: Made with care for the ummah.

About.metaDescription: Why we built a mindful Islamic tracker — our values, the people we build for, and how Ibadah supports your worship without ads, leaderboards, or guilt.
About.lead: Ibadah is a quiet companion for the daily life of a Muslim — Salah, Quran, Dhikr, fasting, charity, dua. Built with care, no ads, no gamification of the deen.
About.story_p1: Most habit apps are built for productivity culture — streaks that punish, leaderboards that compare, ads that interrupt. The deen deserves a different kind of tool.
About.story_p2: We wanted a private notebook for worship: gentle, beautiful, multilingual, and respectful. A place to log Awwal-time Fajr without shame on the day it slipped to last-time. A place to keep returning.
About.story_p3: Ibadah is the result. It's free, it's open in spirit, and it grows from the practical needs of the people who use it every day.
About.value_privacy_desc: Your worship log belongs to you. We store the minimum, encrypt in transit, and never sell, share, or train models on your records.
About.value_no_ads_desc: We will not surround your dhikr with advertising. Ibadah is sustained as a sadaqah jariyah, not a funnel.
About.value_respect_desc: We don't issue fatwas, we don't rank madhhabs, and we don't add features that frame worship as competition.
About.value_localized_desc: Every text — Arabic, Bangla, English — is written by a real human with the rhythm of the language in mind. RTL is first-class, not an afterthought.
About.for_title: Wherever you are on the path
About.for_body: Beginners learning the prayers, the steady ones who've prayed five times daily for years, and the returning souls finding the path again — Ibadah is built to meet each of you with warmth, not performance pressure.
About.verse: And that man can have nothing but what he strives for. And that his striving will soon be seen.
About.cta_subtitle: Create a free account, choose your language, log one Salah today. Let the week compound.
